senses.gloss: , נְוַל II (denom. of next w.) to weave.
units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 95a:10">Snh. 95ᵃ</cite> <he>דהות נָוְולָא</he> (Ms. M. <he>קא טויא</he>; early ed. <he>קא נוזלא</he>; Ms. F. <he>קא עזלא</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) was weaving.
<cite ref="Gittin 34a:3">Gitt. 34ᵃ</cite> <he>יתבא ונָוְולָה</he> she was sitting and weaving.
